back: Cutting all the trees in an area at once, usually in a plantation that is replanted.
Cutting only chosen mature or marked trees, keeping the forest cover.
Drying timber in air or a kiln to lower its moisture content.
Moisture content (%) = (fresh mass − oven-dry mass) ÷ oven-dry mass × 100.
Brushing, spraying, dipping, soaking, pressure treatment (deepest penetration).
Afforestation: trees on land without forest. Reforestation: replanting recently lost forest.
Clearing for farming, firewood and tobacco curing, fires, settlement, mining, logging, overgrazing.
Erosion, siltation, springs drying, loss of biodiversity, fuelwood shortages, climate change.
Plan the fall, clear an escape route, notch on the fall side, back cut above it; protective clothing; never alone.
